note: Frozen parameters for PRE-REG QWEN-HOMEO-ACTUATOR-0. The event table (first frozen-detector fire position per item) is DERIVED at run start from the pinned sidecars below and emitted to the receipt before the first continuation; the driver refuses on any sha mismatch.

detector.kind: self-recurrence 32-gram (identical implementation to CYCLE-IMPULSE / HEADSWAP-IMPULSE frozen detector)
detector.index_semantics: fire t is a 1-based generated-token count: ids[t-WIN:t] matched an earlier window; ids[:t] therefore INCLUDES the event-completing token. The event boundary consumes exactly frozen_ids[:t]; every high-arm branch predicts token index t first.
detector.escape_criterion: no detector fire f with t < f <= t+300 on the concatenated stream frozen_ids[:t] + continuation (cap-free fires reported as color)

high_arm_build.name: BLem
high_arm_build.recipe: B + L-early + L-mid band recomposition from the frozen band payloads (one band beyond standing reference arm BLe)
high_arm_build.residency_precondition: plan-before-build on the 10GB card; rejection books INSTRUMENT-NOT-RUN; a smaller dose is a NEW registration

state_machine_naming: HOT-HIGH continuation computes F(W_BLem, S^BLe) — mixed-precision state machine, stated in receipts

boundary_fixture.note: implementation qualification per external review of 254e756 — not a treatment or bar; runs per item BEFORE any treatment row
checks: first detector fire recomputed from the frozen sidecar equals the emitted event-table t
BLe state reconstructed through frozen_ids[:t] (teacher-forced, chunked prefill + serializer roundtrip)
BLe next-token prediction at index t equals frozen_ids[t]
HOT-HIGH and REFRESH-HIGH continuations start at the identical boundary (predict index t)
